text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on all four legs of this intersection, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval from City Council to reconfigure the intersection of The Queensway, Queen Street West, King Street West and Roncesvalles Avenue, as well as the approaches to the intersection. Also, this report includes required traffic and parking regulation amendments associated with this project. This project will improve public transportation, pedestrian environment, the public realm and traffic circulation in this area.
Item TE3.37 was withdrawn from the Agenda.
